name: Mount Kilimanjaro
tagline: Africa's highest mountain at 5,895 metres, a free-standing volcano with glaciers on the equator.
highlight: Standing on Uhuru Peak at sunrise after a midnight summit push.
shortDescription: A trekkable giant with five climate zones, several routes, a UNESCO listing and gentler options like day hikes in the foothills and coffee farms.
metaDescription: A Mount Kilimanjaro guide: Machame, Lemosho, Marangu, Rongai and Northern Circuit routes, how many days, altitude sickness, costs, guides and porters.

budget: US$2,000-5,000 per person for a climb

image.alt: Hikers on Uhuru Peak, the summit of Mount Kilimanjaro

intro: Kilimanjaro rises from the plains of northern Tanzania to 5,895 metres, the highest point in Africa and the tallest free-standing mountain in the world. It has three volcanic cones: Kibo, Mawenzi and Shira, and Uhuru Peak on the rim of Kibo is the summit most climbers aim for.

It is one of the few seven-summit peaks that needs no technical climbing skills. The trek passes through five ecological zones: farmland, rainforest, heath and moorland, alpine desert and the arctic summit. Several routes lead to the top, with different lengths, difficulty and scenery.

Altitude is the real challenge. Longer routes give your body more time to adapt, and success rates are much higher on seven- to nine-day itineraries. Climbs must be arranged through a licensed operator, with guides, cooks and porters, and the mountain's permit fees are significant. You do not have to reach the top to enjoy the lower slopes, which offer day walks, waterfalls and coffee farm tours.

whyVisit.intro: Kilimanjaro is a bucket-list adventure that anyone fit and well-prepared can attempt.
